sources.title: 越南国家图书馆 R.293《安紫微國語歌》喃文抄本及数字登记
sources.provider: National Library of Vietnam / Vietnamese Nôm Preservation Foundation
sources.quality_notes: Anonymous undated 54-page Nôm handwritten copy. Imaging date 2008-08-15 is not a composition or copy date. The page viewer identifies the same R.293 and NLVNPF-0508. No visual glyph collation.

sources.title: 越南汉喃研究院4992《紫微斗數》索书号群及合抄参见
sources.provider: Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences / Institute of Hán-Nôm Studies
sources.quality_notes: Ten shelfmarks and a separate cross-reference VHv.773 p.95. Entry lists VHv.163 whereas Volkov figure caption has VHb.163. Entry also has VHb.160 in the list vs VHv.160 in the description. No copy merge, edition chronology or provenance adjudication.

sources.title: 中研院馆目《紫微斗數解音》AB.316及AB.552
sources.provider: Academia Sinica Institute of Chinese Literature and Philosophy / Vietnam Hán-Nôm Institute holdings
sources.quality_notes: Two distinctly cataloged manuscripts of 56 and 28 pages. The 56-page record reports an appended 醫論. Catalog summary describes Nôm verse explanations; original leaves not examined.

sources.title: 中研院馆目《紫微十二宮斷法國音歌》AB.424
sources.provider: Academia Sinica Institute of Chinese Literature and Philosophy / Vietnam Hán-Nôm Institute holdings
sources.quality_notes: Catalog describes 36 pages of Nôm verse with Han material and 91 pages for the whole catalog object. No reading of its astrology rules or source exemplar.

sources.title: 中研院馆目《紫微數》VHb.165
sources.provider: Academia Sinica Institute of Chinese Literature and Philosophy / Vietnam Hán-Nôm Institute holdings
sources.quality_notes: 136-page Han manuscript with some Nôm and reported ritual appendices. No identity or transmission link to the short title in the Joseon exam list.

sources.title: 中研院馆目《占論事年月日辰跡》VHb.95
sources.provider: Academia Sinica Institute of Chinese Literature and Philosophy / Vietnam Hán-Nôm Institute holdings
sources.quality_notes: 90 pages. Catalog summary names natal eight characters among several divination uses. The day-master, ten-god, month-command mechanics and copy date are unknown.

sources.title: 中研院馆目《占夫妻嫁娶合婚吉凶數》VHv.742
sources.provider: Academia Sinica Institute of Chinese Literature and Philosophy / Vietnam Hán-Nôm Institute holdings
sources.quality_notes: 136 pages. Catalog summary names birth eight characters in matching, with Han interspersed with Nôm. No exact Ziping rule or printing date adjudicated.

sources.title: 法国远东学院《Connaissance du Viêt-Nam》1954年版目录
sources.quality_notes: Publisher establishes 1954 edition, 356 pages, Huard and Durand, Hanoi and Paris. Page 66 was not collated.

sources.title: Alexei Volkov 2013《Astrology and Hemerology in Traditional Vietnam》
sources.quality_notes: DOI 10.4000/extremeorient.282. Printed pp.115,127–128 and appendix A1,A47–A52. Author cites Huard and Durand p.66 and reports the named Quanshu holding was not located. Figure 2 caption uses VHb.163. Secondary report, no manuscript glyph authority.

sources.title: 越南2011国家书目《子平真詮》越译 p.33第497条
sources.quality_notes: s288559. Hanoi, Hồng Đức, 543pp. Credits Thẩm Hiếu Thiêm, commentary by Từ Lạc Ngô and translation by Chu Tước Nhi. Uyên hải tử bình is the series field. Exact exemplar, first Vietnamese translation and rules unbound.

unresolved_lineage_questions: When were the separate Nôm manuscripts copied and what narrative units and Chinese or Vietnamese exemplars were used?
Can the catalog spelling and the academic figure caption be reconciled at physical-object and leaf level?
Does either natal-input manuscript independently attest day-master, ten-god, or other specific Ziping mechanics?
Which Chinese edition underlies the 2011 Vietnamese annotated translation, and what earlier dated Vietnamese reception witnesses survive?
